UIDAI works with a strong ecosystem of Registrars, Enrolment Agencies, Operators, OVSE, Certification Bodies and Technology Partners to deliver secure and seamless Aadhaar services across India. Together, these partners support enrolment, updates, authentication, training, certification and innovation, helping build a trusted digital identity platform for every resident.

SITAA
The Scheme for Innovation and Technology Association with Aadhaar (SITAA) is a strategic initiative by UIDAI to foster a culture of open innovation and co-creation around India’s Identity Technology (ID Tech) ecosystem.
